ev.q: During 2003--2004, the annual average diabetes death rate per 1 million youths was 2.46 for black youths and 0.91 for white youths.
diabetes death rates were calculated as 2-year annual averages for the period 1979--2004
During 2003--2004, an annual average of 89 diabetes deaths occurred among persons aged 1--19 years
CDC analyzed data on deaths with an underlying cause of diabetes among persons aged 1--19 years
Trend analysis for black youths indicated a decrease in death rates during 1979--1998

methods_quotes.q: Trends over time for 2-year annual averages were assessed using Hudson's algorithm in statistical software
Rate ratios and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for death rates of blacks compared with death rates of whites were calculated for each 2-year interval.
Age-adjusted rates were examined and determined to be identical to crude rates.
The numbers of diabetes deaths in other racial groups were too small to obtain reliable estimates
